name: ExampleResponse
doc: Represents a response received from a tested API

props.name: testedApiVersionId
props.doc: ID of the tested API (document) version

props.name: statusId
props.doc: ID of the response (status) documentation entry that matches the received response

props.name: relativeFilePath
props.doc: Path to the file where the response body is stored. Relative to the examples directory.

name: ExamplePropertyValue
doc: Documents a single property value received from a tested API

props.name: responseId
props.doc: ID of the response that contained this value

props.name: propId
props.doc: ID of the property schema that matches the received property
